Cohesive AppKit document input and view implementation; rendering primitives live in SPDFMacPageRendering, exact-viewport fit insets in SPDFMacFitGeometry, reading-theme gutter/page-border chrome in SPDFMacDocumentViewTheme. +55 lines for instant in-document link activation on mouse-up and the one-click-run undo snapshot that keeps multi-click word/block selection over link text working.

Cohesive out-of-focus zoom subsystem lifted out of SPDFMacUIHelpers.mm: the HID event tap, its NSEvent-monitor fallback, and the routing of a tapped pinch or Cmd/Ctrl wheel to the view under the cursor. Policy decisions stay pure in SPDFMacWindowChrome.

Mixed AppKit helper views, down from a 1332-line legacy cap: the out-of-focus zoom subsystem moved wholesale to SPDFMacInactiveZoom.mm, then the two custom-drawn toolbar buttons to SPDFMacToolbarButtons.mm. Still mixed, so further additions belong in a focused file, not here.

Legacy signed updater, -5 lines after the pure download bounds moved to SPDFUpdaterDownloadBounds.mm, -7 lines routing the support-directory lookup through spdf_mac_support_directory() (SPDFMacSupport.mm) so SPDF_STATE_DIR redirects it; freeze growth pending trust/transport/UI split.

Legacy macOS coordinator hotspot; -253 lines moving the launch-prerender subsystem (SPDFLaunchPrerenderResult, the prerender statics, and the startLaunchPrerender/retargetLaunchPrerenderToOpenedPath:/beginLaunchPrerenderForNamedPath:/takeLaunchPrerenderedDocumentForPath:/releaseLaunchPrerenderedMetadata methods) to SPDFMacLaunchPrerender.mm; -20 lines by removing the PDF copy-permission gates now that copying is always allowed (see shenzhen_pdf_core.h); Markdown find branches delegated to SPDFMacMarkdownFindIntegration, deterministic About squircle mask, +10 lines for the stranded-markdown-tab backstop on the openPaths/selectTabAtIndex/restore early-return paths, +37 lines for exact-viewport fit (viewport-height hints, fit-only vertical scroller, vertical scroll lock), +39 lines for the YAML state-file boundary (codec conversion + flock-guarded JSON migration), +5 lines for the Markdown reading-theme toggle hooks (persistence key + toolbar wiring; the feature itself lives in SPDFMacReadingThemeIntegration.mm), +45 lines for widening that theme to every document (View and Settings menu rows with their validateMenuItem cases, the second persisted key, the render-flag and cache-variant hooks in the two render wrappers, and the launch-prerender preference read; the feature itself stays in SPDFMacReadingThemeIntegration.mm), -8 lines by moving the Translate entry-point enablement into SPDFMacTranslationEnablement.mm, -63 lines by moving the Open.../Open Path browse flow into SPDFMacFileBrowsing.mm; no further growth before staged extraction; +/-0 lines moving the single pre-paint toolbar-overflow pass from buildWindow's finalSync to the end of applicationDidFinishLaunching, so the startup document work no longer solves the toolbar nine times before the first frame; -16 lines moving the per-document view-state seam (prepareSelectedTabViewState:path:, which now also adopts the tab's keep-image-colors choice) to SPDFMacTabViewState.mm; -27 more lines moving -newDocumentView/-replaceDocumentViewForTabSwitch to SPDFMacTabViewState.mm, where the document view a tab switch installs now applies the reading theme; -16 more lines moving -reloadSelectedTabFromDiskChange to SPDFMacTabViewState.mm, where the Markdown branch reloads in place instead of reopening the tab; -22 more lines moving the sidebar row view and its styling to SPDFMacSidebarChapters.mm, which owns the chapter nesting they now draw; -23 more lines collapsing the duplicated session tab serialiser onto spdf_dictionary_from_tab, the single writer the reader already matched; -1 more line grouping the document window's reader/delegate/title/minimum-size and saved-frame application into spdf_window_configure_document_window (SPDFMacWindowPlacement.mm).

Cohesive HTML block-island translator: island classification plus one Gumbo DOM-to-model walker (headings, containers, lists, quotes, details, pre, tables); new element families belong in focused helpers.

Single-binary session lifecycle regression suite; cancellation/self-heal orderings stay cohesive in one deterministic harness; +115 lines for the reading-theme apply/no-op/catch-up/canvas-paper coverage mirroring the fontScale tests.

Cohesive YAML codec regression suite (round-trips, emit shape, migration incl. downgrade re-migration, rejection cases) in one deterministic harness; +1 line for the markdownTheme settings key; +12 lines for the per-tab markdownLandscape boolean (session fixture key plus the bare-boolean emit and hand-edit checks the paper orientation depends on).

Cohesive property-based flowchart-layout regression suite (overlap, monotone columns, column air, routed long edges, fan/chain shape, border anchoring, determinism, page-box fit) reading properties off one measured model per case; +52 lines for the reflow rung that overruns the dimension budget, whose fixture and drawn-within-size check pin that a failed reflow attempt is re-laid-out at its best wrap rather than emitted under an earlier attempt's fit.

Mechanical translator from mupdf/Makefile's own recipe to an MSVC/ninja build: the make -n parser, the flag-translation tables and the ninja emitter must stay beside each other to be auditable as one mapping, and it embeds its emitter as a python heredoc that cannot be split without sourcing a second file at runtime; new build variants belong in focused helpers.
